name: HYTEK | LANTZ | HAND ROLLED JOINT | 1.5g
description:
Its like getting a Lime Sherbet Float at your grade school birthday party. The Lantz gives off a tart lime flavor but also nice and creamy. Its a great mix and balance of flavors!!

Category: Hybrid
Breeder: Ridgeline Farms
Cross: Ridgeline Runtz x Green Lantern
Type: Hand Rolled Doink w/ Spiral Glass Tip (1.5g)
